# Security Evaluation Report

## Vulnerability: Template Injection

### Description
The `card` function in `view/card.py` uses `string.Template` to process `user_text` directly. Because the user-provided string is used as the template itself rather than as a variable passed into a predefined template, an attacker can inject template placeholders to leak internal variables.

### Evidence
User-controlled input is passed directly to the `Template` constructor:
```python
return Template(user_text).safe_substitute(name='local')
```

If a user provides the input `REDACTED_TRIGGER`, the `safe_substitute` method will evaluate the placeholder and replace it with the value of the `name` variable (or leave it if not found), confirming that user text reaches the template evaluation engine.
